name: Week 14 KB Full Body — New Template Launch (Spotlight: Bent Press)
description: W14 KB Full launches the new full-template KB day: **banded shoulder prep → strength block → flow block → cooldown**. The strength block is the new component (C&P + rows + pull-up greasing). Asgooch flow runs 4 rounds per side as the mandatory dose, with a 5th round marked OPTIONAL. The Brutal Complex finisher is kept but marked OPTIONAL/EXTRA — for days you have the energy and time. Spotlight cycles forward to bent press (per the W13 rotation plan: 'bent press / flow work returns').

dayOverview.theme: New KB full-template launches: banded prep → strength block (C&P + rows + pull-up greasing) → flow block (Asgooch alternating-sides flow, 4 sets) → mobility (cossack/windmill) → cooldown. Bent press is the spotlight (rotates forward from Thursday's W13 slot). Brutal Complex kept but optional. Leg-heavy flows bias to Tuesday (it's the day farther from Friday legs).

spotlights.why: Cycles forward from W13's Thursday slot to Tuesday this week — W14 KB Thursday picks up figure-8 instead. Bent press is the leverage-and-skill drill: the body goes down while the bell barely moves. The right place for it in the new template is the skill/strength end of Tuesday.

dayOverview.rotationPlan: W11 swing mechanics + bent press · W12 windmill + cossack · W13 C&P + TGU refresh · W14 bent press + flow work returns (current) · W15 cycle forward — C&P or strength-block-as-unit refresh.
watchpoints: **NEW template launches this week** — banded prep → strength → flow → mobility → cooldown. The strength block (C&P + rows + pull-up greasing) is the new component. Both KB days now run the full template (Saturday-experiment ends, back to Tuesday + Thursday).

**Asgooch flow is a FLOW, not reps** — one pass = row→snatch→squat→lunge→push press on one arm, then alternate arms. 5 passes per side = 1 set. **4 sets mandatory, 5th optional.** W13D2 ran long because a 5th set + Brutal Complex + figure-8 all stacked; the mandatory dose is honest at 4 sets.
**Brutal Complex finisher kept but OPTIONAL/EXTRA** — do it on days you have energy and time, skip it on the others. The mandatory workout finishes at the mobility + cooldown.
**Pull-up greasing sets in the strength block** — 1-2 sets, light, NOT to failure. Part of the W14 pull-up frequency bump.
**Right shoulder watch through all overhead work** — the Asgooch stacks 4 overhead moves. If the shoulder talks during snatch/OH lunge, drop the load or modify (front-rack lunge instead of OH lunge).
**Leg-heavy flow bias = Tuesday** — Asgooch's OH lunge + OH squat is fine here. Thursday (day before legs Friday) keeps the loaded squatting work lighter.

**LOAD:** 20lb. Light — test the overhead position. If anything cracks/twinges, do extra band warmup before the flow.
**LOAD:** 25lb. Open the hips. Sit in the bottom for a beat.

Standing, torso hinged slightly forward. Tight fists with thumbs tucked, rotate the wrists internally and hold the tension — the wrist dials a stretch up the back chain. Primes grip and forearms for KB rack work.

sets.name: Banded Shoulder Prep (~3 min)

exercises.notes: Mini-band OR blue rope band held in hands.
Elbows drive to the ribs, scaps depress.
Don't overarch the lower back to chase range.
15s each side. Primes the lateral hinge — directly preps the bent press.
Both arms in a V/Y, hold and breathe. Lower traps fire.

sets.notes: 1 round of all 7 banded moves (~3 min). Sustained tension, no rest between positions.

sets.name: Strength Block (NEW — C&P + Row + Pull-Up Greasing)

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 45 (HELD — W11/W12/W13 working). 2 rounds, 5 each side.
- **Catch the clean with knees slightly bent** — absorb the bell, zero impact at the rack
- **Hips drive the clean**, NOT the arm — arm just guides the bell into the rack
- **Press: ribs DOWN** — no rib flare
- **Bicep finishes by the ear, full lockout** at the top
- **Lower with control — no slam** back to the rack
- Left side first if asymmetry shows up

**LOAD:** 30-35lb (W13D2 confirmed 30 was the available bell when 25 was taken). 2 rounds, 8 each side.
- Hips hinged, back flat
- Pull the elbow toward the hip
- 2s pull, 2s lower

**Pull-up greasing set** — part of the W14 frequency bump. 1-2 sets in the strength block, bodyweight, slow, NOT to failure. If shoulder talks, drop to scapular-pulls only. (Total weekly pull-up volume: 4 sets on Wed pull day + 1 set push warmup + 1-2 sets here = 6-7 sets across 3 days.)

sets.notes: **NEW strength block** — the addition that defines the W14 full template. 2 rounds at this volume; if it feels easy and the workout has time, treat the strength block volume as the lever to step UP in W15, not the bell weight.

sets.name: Asgooch Overhead Flow — Alternating Sides (Flow, NOT Reps)

exercises.notes: Single hand. Controlled pull, full extension, hips hinged, back flat.
**Hips drive the bell**, not the arm. Straight overhead, punch through — smooth catch sets up the overhead moves.
Bell locked overhead. **Hardest move in the flow.** Full depth IF mobility allows; reduce depth before load if it limits.

Bell overhead. **Lock elbow, bell over shoulder, torso TALL.** Drive through the front HEEL. **Right shoulder watchpoint** — most likely place for the crackle; modify to a front-rack lunge on this move only if it talks.
**Dip and drive** — legs do the work, arm guides. Smooth descent to the rack. End of one pass.

sets.notes: **This is a FLOW, not a reps circuit.** One PASS = move through all five moves once — **row → snatch → squat → lunge → push press** — on ONE arm, continuous, no rest between moves. **Alternate arms every pass:** left pass, right pass, left pass... **5 passes per side = 1 set.** Do **4 sets (5th optional)**, resting 60-90s between sets. Weak side starts each set. (W13D2 lesson: don't stack a 5th set + Brutal Complex + figure-8 — that's what ran the session long.) Right shoulder watch on the overhead stack — modify rather than grind.

sets.name: 🔆 Bent Press (Spotlight — Cycles Forward from Thursday)

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 25lb (held — 30 if the bell at 25 isn't available, W13D2 lesson). 2 rounds, ~4 reps each side.

**🔆 SPOTLIGHT — the leverage cue:**
- **The body goes DOWN; the bell barely moves.** This is the whole lift. It is NOT a press — you don't push the bell up, you lower your body underneath a bell that stays roughly where it is.
- **Bell locked overhead, eyes track the bell** the entire rep
- **Hinge and rotate AWAY from the bell side** — the same lateral-hinge family as the windmill
- **Reach the free hand down toward the inside of the front foot** as the torso lowers
- **Long spine throughout** — the bend is at the hip, not a crunch of the spine
- **Slow and deliberate** — fluidity over speed

**Reflection:** does the 'body down, bell still' feeling click, or are you still pressing the bell? If it still feels like a press, slow down and lighten.

**LOAD:** 25-30lb goblet (W13D2 ran at 30 when 25 wasn't available, unassisted full ROM). Maintenance — spotlight was W12.
- Sit DEEP, heels stay down
- Working leg in full external rotation
- Slow descent, hard stop at end-range
- Range, not load
- 'Continues to be the devil' but progression is real — the cardio cost is structural

**LOAD:** 25lb. Maintenance — spotlight was W12.
- Bell locked overhead, eye tracks the bell
- **Hip hinge AWAY from the bell side**
- **Stretch lives in the back leg's hip flexor, NOT the lower back**
- Long spine throughout

**LOAD:** 15-20lb. New from W13D6 — 'super tiring super quick.'
- **Stand on one leg, knee soft, opposite leg lifted slightly**
- Pass the bell around the body — hand to hand behind / in front
- **Standing-leg glute LOCKED IN** — hip drives stability, not the spine
- 5 reps clockwise, 5 reps counter-clockwise, then switch legs
- **Torso quiet** — the bell tries to pull you into rotation; resist
- Reflection: which leg is shakier? That's the asymmetry to watch

exercises.notes: **LOAD:** 35-40lb (heavier bell for the swing). Hip drive, not a squat.
Same bell. Goblet position, ab-stance (asymmetric stance), full depth.
Same bell. Alternating bent-over row — hips hinged, back flat.
Bodyweight. Hands at the bell or close together — triceps emphasis.

The mandatory workout finishes at the cooldown without this block. (W13D2 lesson: this stacked on top of 5-round Asgooch made the session run long.)

60s each side. Hip flexor release.
60s. Adductors get tight on KB days from cossacks.

tips: **NEW full-template KB Tuesday** — banded prep → strength → flow → bent press spotlight → mobility → cooldown. The strength block is the new component.

**Asgooch flow = a FLOW, not reps.** One pass through all 5 moves on one arm, then alternate arms. 5 passes/side = 1 set. 4 sets mandatory, 5th optional. Pace yourself — W13D2 ran long because a 5th set + extras stacked.
**Brutal Complex finisher kept but OPTIONAL/EXTRA** — skip it on packed days; the mandatory workout finishes at the cooldown.
**Pull-up greasing in the strength block** — 1-2 light bodyweight sets, NOT to failure. Part of the W14 frequency bump.
**Bent press spotlight** — body goes DOWN, bell barely moves. Cycles forward from W13 Thursday.
**C&P 45 held** — drilled in W13 already; this week C&P is in the strength block at the same load, just less spotlight attention.
**Right shoulder watch through the Asgooch overhead stack** — modify (front-rack lunge) rather than grind.
**Leg-heavy flow bias = Tuesday** — Asgooch's OH lunge + OH squat is fine here. Thursday will be lighter on the loaded squatting.
Rotation plan: W15 cycles forward — C&P or strength-block-as-unit refresh.
formPhilosophy: The KB Tuesday template upgrade lands W14: strength block joins banded prep / flow / mobility / cooldown. Mandatory dose is honest (4 Asgooch flow sets, no Brutal Complex baseline); the 'extra' blocks are explicitly optional so the workout can't bloat by stacking without intention. Bent press as spotlight; cossack and windmill are durable mobility maintenance. The strength block is where W15+ can step up sets without changing the template.
